item.title: Minneapolis firm gets $610M contract to build sterile fly facility to fight screwworm
item.description: A Minnesota company has been awarded a $610 million contract to help stop New World screwworm from spreading north from Mexico across the border into South Texas.

item.title: New week brings same weather
